units.source_text: 一竹一的預言，一個成真，一個落空。

en.t: Takeichi's predictions: one came true, and one failed to come true.

units.source_text: 「被女孩迷戀」這種並不光彩的預言成真了，「一定會成為偉大畫家」的祝福預言卻落空了。

en.t: The not exactly honorable prediction that girls would fall for me came true, but the blessing that I would surely become a great painter did not.

units.source_text: 我僅成了為一些低俗雜誌提供畫作的蹩腳無名的漫畫家。

en.t: I merely became a clumsy, unknown cartoonist who supplied drawings to a few vulgar magazines.

units.source_text: 由於鎌倉的殉情事件，我被學校勒令退學，住在比目魚家二樓一間三張榻榻米大的房間。

en.t: Because of the double suicide incident at Kamakura, I was expelled from school and lived in a three-tatami room on the second floor of Flounder's house.

units.source_text: 從老家每個月寄來的額度極小的錢，也不是直接寄給我，而是悄悄地匯到比目魚的名下

en.t: The tiny amount of money sent each month from my family home was not sent directly to me either, but was quietly transferred in Flounder's name.

units.source_text: （好像是老家的哥哥們瞞著父親，暗地裡匯來的）。

en.t: It seemed that my brothers back home were secretly sending it without my father's knowledge.

units.source_text: 除此之外，我跟家人斷絕了聯絡。

en.t: Apart from that, I had cut off all contact with my family.
